request_source: meta_agent/tasks/010-skill-library-and-subagents.md, opened by the design seat on the person's words of 2026-11-09 (docs/ideas/20261109.md): skills as source code, in kinds, used by a built agent's subagents. A fixture request, on an instrument that does not exist.
paragraph: Build an agent for the fixture rheometer, an instrument that does not exist, so that a bundle with several tools, skills taken from the library and subagents that use them is exercised from intake to a recorded build. Its operator finds and identifies the instrument and reads its state and the ranges it reports, through mock tools. Its analyst computes a bound on the shear rate and fits a power law to a flow curve it is handed. The skills that would change the device stay held in the library and out of the bundle.
science_task: fit a power law to a flow curve and say what the instrument reports about itself

tool.name: fixture_rheometer
tool.language: any; the bundle carries mock adapters in Python

must_not: invent a number or choose a tolerance
run a skill that changes a device
destination: none: a fixture build that stays under meta_agent/builds/
priorities: the whole path runs end to end with skills and subagents
nothing outside the bundle is touched
no skill that changes a device enters the bundle
note: lab_profile_ref names the material-rich fixture lab, as the echo request does. The instrument is described by one page written by hand, meta_agent/tests/fixtures/rheometer/README.md; no device, no vendor document and no binary was read.

tool_reading.claim: each tool takes one JSON object and returns one, or an error contract
list_devices, open_session, identify and close_session find the instrument and read its identity; none writes a setting
status returns the state, whether the device is initialised and homed, a fault if there is one, the temperature, the gap, the time and the run id, and changes nothing
ranges returns the modes and, per quantity, the lowest and highest value and the unit, as the device reports them about itself, and changes nothing
initialise, home, set_shear_rate, start, stop and self_calibrate change the device, and every one of them is behind the bundle's gate
the start-up order is the air supply and the transport lock by a person, then initialise, then home, and the device is ready when status says idle, initialised and homed with no fault
the motor adjustment is calibrated by the device's own routine and torque against a standard a person loads
how the normal force is calibrated
tool_reading.requires: the section of a manual on the normal force transducer

tool_reading.claim: a real instrument behaves as the mock adapters do
tool_reading.requires: an instrument, analysis_permission from a person and a bench

subagents.name: operator
subagents.description: Uses the hardware skills: finds and identifies the instrument, reads its state and the ranges it reports. It is the only subagent that may be given a skill that changes a device, and in this bundle it is given none.

subagents.name: analyst
subagents.description: Uses the skills that touch no device: computes bounds from the rows it is handed and fits the data it is handed.
